entities.name: 2008 Murshidabad beheading
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The 2008 Murshibad murder was the beheading of Shailendra Prasad, a Hindu labourer from Bihar for marrying Munira Bibi a Muslim girl from West Bengal, on the orders of a shalishi court in Murshidabad on 14 July 2008. Munira Bibi, the widow of the victim, eventually regretted her ill-fated visit to her parental home where she lost her husband.
